answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond, slashed when audits establish that several identities coordinate to claim duplicate rewards. Auditors compare shared funding, synchronized actions, and repeated claims; no single match is enough to punish an honest user. Keep bonds locked through a glacier-long challenge window, so a fake swarm ties up capital and delays profit. At nadir, honest agents reclaim their bonds, while a caught attacker loses the stake and must fund new identities. Ongoing audits keep a pulse on evasion.
